results.title: Copy paste is still broken | Figma Forum
results.content:
Title: Copy paste is still broken | Figma Forum
# Copy paste is still broken. Whenever I try using copy/paste in Figma it’s a gamble if the copied frame, or components will actually be copied and pasted correctly. Here is the common issue:. Select an element > cmd+C > go somewhere else in the file > cmd+V. Now about half the time it pastes something that was previously on the clipboard instead of the thing I just copied. It’s really frustrating and sometimes takes multiple attempts to copy paste something. This has been an issue for at least 2 years at this point. ## 2 replies. I completely understand your frustration I’m dealing with the same issue. I’m designing a store for a client who sells gym accessories like a dip belt with chain, and it’s been quite a headache. They really need to address this problem because it’s causing significant delays. Sometimes, when I upload images, they don’t show up, and instead, a broken product image of the dip belt with chain appears when viewing the project. Just today, I double checked everything before sharing the file with my client, but when we were on a Zoom call, one image still showed up as broken. It was a close call, and I almost lost the client over it. Figma really needs to look into this and fix it. Or it might be issue on my side can’t understand it’s not an negative feedback btw. Hey All, thanks for flagging this and sorry to hear this is happening! Are you able to share your files with us, so we can investigate and try to work on a fix? results.title: New Figma interface layout is frustrating to use | Figma Forum
results.content:
Title: New Figma interface layout is frustrating to use | Figma Forum
* New Figma interface layout is frustrating to use. The toolbar is now a floating bar in the centre of the bottom of the page making it look like something has been put in the way of the design space, the same for the left and right sections of the interface, these now feel like immovable boxes on top of my design rather than having a solid, neatly contained design space - I appreciate the extra space, but if that’s what we want, just allow for greater collapsibility of the left and right sections or make things slightly smaller to fit more into one space without compromising on readability. Seeing a tiny sliver of my design on the far side of each sidebar is useless to me - push them flush to the sides. I struggle to navigate the right-hand sidebar, it doesn’t feel intuitive even after 2 weeks of constant use, navigating so many changes brought about in this new layout, slowing me down amid a time-sensitive project. This topic has been closed for replies. Hey @Jennifer\_Don, thanks for the feedback! Everything you’ve mentioned is already on the UI3 team’s radar for improvement - stay tuned! ## 11 replies. Another vote for the ability to dock the toolbar at the top (vs. having to switch the whole interface back to the original design). This would respect Fitt’s law by co-locating controls and reducing the time spent trying to move around the interface to find controls. Also, most users of Figma are working in browsers or desktop apps, which also tend to organize their controls at the top or sides (like the tab bar in the browser). ## Sign up. #### Login with SSO. ## Login to the community.
